Title: Azure Scheduler available in Brazil South region

Body.Content: Users can now create Azure Scheduler jobs in the Brazil South region. For more information, visit the Scheduler page. To see all of the available regions and pricing, visit the Scheduler Pricing Details page.
Body.Markdown:
Users can now create Azure Scheduler jobs in the Brazil South region.

For more information, visit the Scheduler page. To see all of the available regions and pricing, visit the Scheduler Pricing Details page.
